inputs.prompt: A cinematic film still, a medium close-up at eye level, of an Indian man in his early fifties at a desk in his home in the evening. He has short greying hair, a neat grey moustache, no beard, thin metal-framed glasses and a comfortable dark green cardigan over a light shirt. He sits behind an open laptop whose plain, unmarked lid is toward the camera in the lower right corner of the frame, so its screen cannot be seen; the screen's soft light touches his face. He is leaning back from the laptop a little, looking at its screen with an amused, half-laughing smile, as if he cannot quite believe what he has just read. A warm desk lamp beside him is the main light: cosy amber lamplight on his face and hands. Behind him, softly out of focus, a dim living room at night with a dark window, a plant and a floor lamp. Deep warm evening tones. 50mm lens at f/2, shallow depth of field, natural skin texture and a true-to-life medium-brown skin tone, no beauty retouching: an ordinary, likeable working person, not a model. Photorealistic, like a frame from a premium advertising film shot on a cinema camera. Nothing written anywhere: no logos, no signs, no labels, no readable text on any object or screen.

expect.unit: USD (the endpoint bills in units of 1 dollar, by tokens)
expect.basis: WP1 paid 6 to 8.5 cents for a 2K picture on this model (demo-video/ledger/wp1.csv)

note: hook-3: the colleague at a home desk under an evening lamp, leaning back from his laptop, half laughing
